proposal.requested_solution: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice
causal_chain: SH-PAY disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on the gateway (E-03)
Gateway timeout retries continue to occur (E-01 shows gateway_timeout_retries ~118‑124 per day)
Without idempotency keys the PSP does not deduplicate the retried capture (E-02 shows all second captures are gateway timeout retries and none sent with an idempotency key)
Duplicate captures create double charges (E-01 shows orders_with_2_captures = 118 on 2026-09-09 and 124 on 2026-09-10)
Increase in double‑charge support tickets follows (E-04 shows ticket spike in weeks W37‑W38)
